documents_issued_complete.name: documents_issued_complete
documents_issued_complete.value:
("documents"."status" = 'draft' and "documents"."number" is null and "documents"."issued_snapshot" is null and "documents"."issued_at" is null)
        or ("documents"."status" in ('issued', 'cancelled') and "documents"."number" is not null and "documents"."financial_year" is not null and "documents"."issued_snapshot" is not null and "documents"."issued_at" is not null)

payments_method.name: payments_method
payments_method.value: ("payments"."kind" = 'payment' and "payments"."method" in ('upi', 'cash', 'bank', 'cheque', 'other')) or ("payments"."kind" = 'adjustment' and "payments"."method" is null)
